description: Claimable returns: counts by eligibility (eligible, filed, approved, rejected, expired), value at stake, and the most urgent claims with their deadlines. Only Amazon SAFE-T and Flipkart disputes are claimable; default window is returns from the last 90 days.

channel.description: Limit to Amazon or Flipkart. Default: both.

since.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2026-10-01, IST day). Default: 90 days ago.

until.description: End date (ISO, inclusive IST day). Default: today.
